title: Basic Mathematical Transforms: sqrt, square, power
description: Demonstrates vectorized square roots, squares, and arbitrary exponents across numerical arrays.
code:
import numpy as np

numbers = np.array([4, 9, 16, 25])

print("Original Array:", numbers)
print("Square Roots (np.sqrt):", np.sqrt(numbers))
print("Squares (np.square):   ", np.square(numbers))
print("Cubes (np.power):      ", np.power(numbers, 3))

title: Rounding & Sign Handling: abs, round, floor, ceil
description: Compare absolute magnitude with three distinct rounding behaviors: round, floor, and ceil.
code:
import numpy as np

values = np.array([-3.8, -1.2, 2.3, 4.7])

print("Original Values:          ", values)
print("Absolute Values (np.abs): ", np.abs(values))
print("Rounded (np.round):       ", np.round(values))
print("Floor (downward):         ", np.floor(values))
print("Ceil (upward):            ", np.ceil(values))

title: Array Aggregations: Total Sum and Mean Average
description: Calculate class totals, benchmarks, and student score deviations from the mean.
code:
import numpy as np

marks = np.array([80, 75, 90, 85, 70])

total = np.sum(marks)
average = np.mean(marks)
deviations = marks - average

print("Student Scores:", marks)
print("Total Marks:   ", total)
print(f"Average Score:  {average:.2f}")
print("Deviations:    ", deviations)

title: Combined Multi-Step Mathematical Pipelines
description: Chain multiple operations to calculate 2D Euclidean distance and Celsius-to-Fahrenheit conversion.
code:
import numpy as np

# 1. 2D Euclidean Distance: sqrt(x^2 + y^2)
x = np.array([3, 5, 6])
y = np.array([4, 12, 8])
distance = np.sqrt(np.square(x) + np.square(y))
print("2D Point Distances:", distance)

# 2. Temperature Conversion with Rounding: (C * 9/5) + 32
celsius = np.array([12.5, 23.8, 31.2])
fahrenheit = (celsius * 9 / 5) + 32
print("Rounded Fahrenheit:", np.round(fahrenheit, 1))
